identity_provenance.statement: dScMgCoin_c is a ROM name, not repository coinage. build/rtti.json carries a real record for it -- module ov006, addr 0x0213bf18, kind si, mangled 11dScMgCoin_c -- and the cartridge bytes at 0x0213bf24 spell 11dScMgCoin_c directly. Nothing about this class name is inferred, so tools/rtti_vtables.py --own dScMgCoin_c answers to the name as written.
identity_provenance.why_this_is_recorded: 143 of the 201 unpromoted rows in notes/data/tu-promotion-queue.tsv carry coined names. --own answers only to the cartridge RTTI spelling and silently finds nothing for a coined one, so the first thing a reader of any facts file needs to know is which kind it is holding. This one is in the ROM-named minority.
identity_provenance.method_names_are_a_separate_question: The RTTI proves the CLASS name only. Of the six own slots, only OnYoshiTryEat carries a member name in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt that is not mechanically derived; InitResources/Behavior/Render are inherited slot names taken from the dScMgBase_c chain, and all 56 helpers are func_ov006_<addr> placeholders.

rtti.evidence: The raw linked ov006 words at 0x0213bf18 are {0x0209a764, 0x0213bf24, 0x020bbf6c}; bytes at 0x0213bf24 decode exactly as the NUL-terminated string '11dScMgCoin_c'. 0x0209a764 is main's abi::__si_class_type_info vtable and ov004's own symbols identify 0x020bbf6c as _ZTI11dScMgBase_c. The same address is unrelated data in overlapping ov000, so the ov006 relocation's module set and the direct ov004 read are material.

base_evidence: The +0x08 word of the class's __si_class_type_info is 0x020bbf6c. Raw ov004 words at that address are {0x0209a764, 0x020bbf84, 0x020914d4}, and ov004 bytes at 0x020bbf84 name '11dScMgBase_c'.
leaf_evidence: A module-qualified scan of every config/**/relocs.txt finds no relocation to 0x0213bf18 except the class's own vtable RTTI pointer at 0x0213bf4c.

class_run.contiguity_evidence: Parsing ov006 symbols gives 62 arm functions whose sizes sum to 0x2b00; every function end equals the next function start, with no byte gap from D1 at 0x020dbe40 through the end of InitResources at 0x020de940. tools/tu_map.py independently reports the same 0x020dbe40..0x020de940 dScMgCoin_c run and 62 functions.

promotion_candidate.basis: The factory begins exactly at the end of the contiguous 62-function class run, constructs this class, stores this class's vtable, and is the g_profile_MG_COIN factory. Those facts make the combined 63-function range the promotion candidate, but adjacency does not by itself prove the original source-file boundary.

reference_evidence.module_filter: Targets were accepted only when the relocation's destination module is overlay(6), avoiding same-address false callers in other overlays.

callback_tables.dispatch_evidence: Behavior at 0x020de6ac indexes eight-byte records, reads the +4 adjustment/tag word, adjusts this, selects the first word as target and blx-dispatches. The raw records below all have zero +4 words. The two runs are separated by the g_profile_MG_COIN record at 0x0213bedc, so they are recorded as two physical segments rather than one invented contiguous table.

object_size.evidence: The factory loads the literal 0x000051e0 from 0x020de97c into r0 at 0x020de944 immediately before the allocation call. promotion_inventory.queue_row: dScMgCoin_c | 61 | 1576 lines | ov006 | has_header yes | already_promoted no | blockers no-legacy-source:2;pragma:2;compiler-only:>=11 | sibling_oracle dScMgSingle3DBase_c | route text-only
promotion_inventory.what_the_61_counts: The queue shard_count of 61 is the number of .text delink SECTIONS inside 0x020dbe40..0x020de988, not the number of functions. The run holds 63 functions; two of them are not delinked at all (see delink_gaps), leaving 61 sections. 60 of those 61 are one-function shard files in src/; the 61st is the factory, which already lives in src/d_s_mg_coin.cpp.

language_mix.note: 45 of the 61 sections are still .c. The C++ flip and the merge are one edit; every .cpp in the run already carries //cpp as its first bytes.

promotion_inventory.matched_state: No section in the run contains the token NONMATCHING, and the queue row carries no unmatched: blocker -- unlike its two larger ov006 neighbours (dScMgTeresa_c unmatched:1, dScMgBomroom_c unmatched:7). All 61 are matched source today.

delink_gaps.meaning: These are the queue no-legacy-source:2. Both are class methods -- each takes this in r0 and reads fields at this+0x5000 -- but neither has a delink section nor a src file, so they stay inside ov006 undecompiled .text. A promoted TU cannot contain them, and the address range 0x020dbe40..0x020de988 therefore cannot be delinked contiguously. This is why promotion_route is text-only.

pragma_sections.hazard: Both carry #pragma opt_common_subs off and #pragma opt_strength_reduction off. Both switches are FILE-GLOBAL in mwccarm 2004/b56 by default -- a bracketed off/on pair does not bind positionally -- so folding these two into a 61-section TU turns them off for all 61 unless #pragma defer_codegen off is set first, which makes the brackets bind but forces an ascending-source rewrite of the whole TU. Measure both arrangements before accepting a partial.

existing_reconstruction.warning: This block is the only part of this file that reads src/ rather than the ROM. It is here so the writer does not re-create work that already exists; nothing in it is evidence about the cartridge.

header.state: already exists and already declares struct dScMgCoin_c : dScMgBase_c with the four own virtuals, a pad from 0x4660, and typedef char dScMgCoin_c_size_must_be_0x51e0[sizeof(dScMgCoin_c) == 0x51e0 ? 1 : -1]. Most of this promotion touches no header.
header.gap: It names 5 of the 32 tail offsets proved below. The other 27 -- 0x5194 through 0x51c4, plus 0x51cc/0x51d0/0x51dd/0x51de/0x51df -- sit inside pad_4660 or pad_51cc today and are reached through raw char* casts in the shards.
header.one_claim_in_it_is_wrong: Its comment says the tree-wide OnYoshiTryEat mislabel landed on slot 17/D0 instead of slot 18. The cartridge does not support that framing: slot 18 (0x020de5b0) IS _ZN11dScMgCoin_c13OnYoshiTryEatEi in ov006 symbols.txt, and slot 17 (0x020dbe64) is the D0 body. src/_ZN11dScMgCoin_cD0Ev.cpp repeats the same sentence. It describes an old mislabel that has since been corrected on both files, but now reads as if the vtable itself were mislabelled, which it is not. Harmless to bytes; do not carry the sentence forward.

data_ownership.finding: ov006 entire .data segment, 0x02133600..0x021402e0, is ONE delink section owned by no file. The class _ZTV, _ZTI, _ZTS, its 25 eight-byte callback records and g_profile_MG_COIN all live in it.
data_ownership.consequence: The promoted TU cannot own its own vtable and must not try to emit one -- naming a vtable also raises the file language mode. It references the table the way src/d_s_mg_coin.cpp already does, as extern int data_ov006_0213bf50[]. Same for the callback table: the 25 records stay in undelinked .data, so the TU emits none of them even though 25 of its functions are their targets.
data_ownership.callback_records_are_individually_symbol: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt names each record data_ov006_<addr> at an 8-byte stride from 0x0213be44, with g_profile_MG_COIN at 0x0213bedc sitting between the 19-record run and the 5-record run.

unproven: That 0x020dbe40..0x020de988 was one original translation unit. The 62-function class run is mechanically contiguous and the factory is immediately adjacent and class-specific, but original file boundaries are not encoded in the ROM.

Whether any of the 56 non-vtable functions had external linkage in the original source. There are 43 module-qualified direct call relocations to the run and every one originates inside it; the remaining named data references are the 24 callback records and six class-vtable slots, but absence of an outside relocation does not prove static linkage.

Source names and semantic signatures for all func_ov006_* helpers and the 24 callback entries. Their addresses, extents, call/reference graph and zero adjustment words are ROM-proven; descriptive names would be hypotheses.
Semantic types, names, signedness and aggregate boundaries for the observed high-tail storage offsets. Only the effective offsets and instruction access widths are proved.

The semantic identity of the four-byte object or state at +0x51c4. The factory passes this+0x51c4 and value 1 to main func_0203b9b4, whose complete body stores one word and returns, but neither function carries RTTI or a recovered type name.

The source form that produces D1 followed by D0 without a Coin D2. The ROM order and symbol absence are facts; an inline in-class destructor is a compiler-reproduction hypothesis for the writer to measure.

Source-style names for inherited placeholder slots Virtual34, Virtual38, Virtual50, Virtual7C, Virtual80, Virtual84, Virtual88 and Virtual8C. Slot numbers and linked targets are exact, but those names are repository coinage.

Whether func_ov006_020dbe9c and func_ov006_020dd0e0 belonged to this original translation unit at all. Both sit inside the contiguous run, both take this in r0 and address this+0x5000 fields, but both are undelinked and unrecovered, so nothing about their source form is established.

Whether the file-global reach of opt_common_subs / opt_strength_reduction can be confined with defer_codegen off on a TU of this size. The two pragma sections are facts; the arrangement that reproduces all 61 is a measurement only stage 4 can make.

The 27 tail offsets proved here that include/dScMgCoin_c.h does not name. Their effective offsets and access widths are ROM-proven; where an aggregate boundary falls among them, and whether the 0x1c-stride and 0x18-stride indexed accesses walk the same array, is not.
